card.name: The word for after Center
card.fires_on: The word "for" (sometimes "will") right after "Center" or "Centre" in the name of an institute or university unit, such as "Center for Human Rights".

modes.label: Center for
modes.description: "for" directly after Center or Centre in a named academic or research unit.
modes.example: University of Southern California Center<< for>> Muslim-Jewish Engagement was created.

modes.label: Lowercase center as subject
modes.description: A word like "will" right after the lowercase noun center, as in a research center's plans.
modes.example: center<< will>> also examine the utilization of greywater irrigation

card.writes: It pushes the model to repeat or continue the word center, as in the name of an institution.
card.plain: It fires on the word after "Center" in the names of university centers, mostly "for".
